text:
evan_partnerships: quick sync  were finalizing Q3 cost model inputs for marketplace + reserved SKU strategy. need the following from each hardware partner by EOD Tue: 1) guaranteed supply floor (min GPU-hrs / month) per region under reserved commitment; 2) exact discount ladder for 1yr/2yr/3yr and any volume breakpoints; 3) average spot reclaim rate and expected usable spot % during peak; 4) marketplace listing fees / promo passthrough rules; 5) standard provisioning lead time for capacity.

lucy_vendor: hey all  sending a short summary now. main callouts: our supply floor = 10k GPU-hrs/mo per region on a 1yr reserve (can increase with 60d lead), discount tiers: 1yr=28%, 2yr=38%, 3yr=50% off list. we charge a 2% marketplace listing fee that we can absorb up to 1% for co-markets (requires simple addendum). spot: usable avg 40% in NA/EU, 18% in APAC; reclaim rate ~0.8 reclaims/hr per 100 instances during busy windows. lead time for committed pool provisioning = 4-6 weeks post-PO.

jorge_fin: thanks lucy. can you provide effective USD/GPU-hr after discounts (post-marketplace credit) for the regions? finance needs both before- and after-credit columns plus a volatility band for spot pricing.

lucy_vendor: sure. quick table (effective after our 1% pass-through credit):
```
NA: before $0.70 -> after $0.693; 1yr reserved -> $0.50; 3yr -> $0.35; spot avg $0.28 (vol +-45%)
EU: before $0.74 -> after $0.731; 1yr -> $0.52; 3yr -> $0.36; spot avg $0.30 (vol +-40%)
APAC: before $0.82 -> after $0.81; 1yr -> $0.60; 3yr -> $0.40; spot avg $0.50 (vol +-60%)
```

simon_ops: lucy, two ops questions: 1) are reserved pools soft-allocated (i.e., we can burst above commit if capacity exists) or strictly hard quotas? 2) any AZ-level maintenance windows or region-wide blackout days we should model into routing fallbacks?

lucy_vendor: reserved pools are soft-allocated; we honor commit first but will allow burst if spare capacity remains. AZ maintenance: we publish planned maintenance 30 days out; historically APAC has quarterly network upgrades that reduce spot depth for ~48h.

nina_pm: timeline check  we need these numbers to finalize the public marketplace SKU pricing annex. whether marketplace fee is modeled as an invoice credit or a separate GTM discount affects the messaging. evan, do we prefer to show the fee as an "after-credit" effective price?

evan_partnerships: yes show after-credit in public annex, but keep gross numbers internally. also call out spot variability in the annex footnote.

jorge_fin: action for finance: i'll normalize to GPU-hr effective cost and compute NPV of 1yr vs 3yr given our expected utilization curves. please include a sensitivity that assumes 25% lower spot depth than vendor claims (conservative case).

contracts-bot: reminder: vendor addendum template available at https://contracts.redwood.example/vendor-addenda/v1.0. Addendum required to pass marketplace credits through to end customers.

lucy_vendor: small addendum: early termination has a ramp penalty of remaining term * 12% on unsettled commit (standard). we'll send a formal CSV with regional rows and columns for before/after credit, lead times, and blackout notes.

simon_ops: can you include preemption signal semantics (how long before reclaim, could we subscribe to a webhook)? the runtime team needs that to tune graceful shutdowns.

lucy_vendor: yes we offer a 120s preemption notice via metadata + optional webhook.

evan_partnerships: great. action items recap: 1) lucy to upload CSV with per-region effective USD/GPU-hr, supply floor, discount ladder, spot variance, lead times (due EOD Tue). 2) jorge to produce normalized GPU-hr table + conservative sensitivity (EOD Thu). 3) nina to update public annex draft with after-credit prices (Fri). 4) contracts-bot/reference for addendum + legal check.

evan_partnerships: anything blocking? :wave:

lucy_vendor: no blockers, will attach file shortly.

jorge_fin: i'll flag if numbers materially change assumptions in the model.

evan_partnerships: thanks team :thumbsup:
